response.overview: Tape 1: This is a compilation of Tapes created by the already extinct Bunny Smiles Company I tried to get as much info as I could about what these tapes are, all I could find was that these tapes were handed to new employees back in 1974-1979 the rest of the tapes seem to be recorded by a new "Facility Caretaker" in the year 1982, Hopefully, I can find more tapes soon. -Anthony
